input_schema.description: A rendered reel, plus optional expectations to check it against.

video.description: Rendered video to validate (mp4/mov). Everything else is optional tuning of what counts as a pass.
video.title: Video

voiceover.description: Optional separate voice-over track. When supplied, the app reports whether it fits inside the video and — if not — whether the part that would be cut contains speech or just trailing silence.
voiceover.title: Voiceover

expected_width.description: Required frame width. 0 disables the check.
expected_width.title: Expected Width

expected_height.description: Required frame height. 0 disables the check.
expected_height.title: Expected Height

require_bt709.description: Require bt709 colour primaries/transfer/matrix. Meta and YouTube reject some non-bt709 tags on upload.
require_bt709.title: Require Bt709

expected_audio_sample_rate.description: Required audio sample rate in Hz. 0 disables.
expected_audio_sample_rate.title: Expected Audio Sample Rate

lufs_tolerance.description: Allowed deviation from target_lufs, in LU.
lufs_tolerance.title: Lufs Tolerance

speech_band_threshold_db.description: Mean volume in the 1-3.4 kHz speech band above which the audio is treated as containing voice. Default sits between a measured music-only mix (-40.6 dB) and the same mix with narration (-27.7 dB).
speech_band_threshold_db.title: Speech Band Threshold Db

voiceover_tail_speech_threshold_db.description: Speech-band level above which the TRUNCATED TAIL of an overrunning voice-over counts as speech rather than silence. Deliberately separate from speech_band_threshold_db: that one discriminates voice inside a full 3-track mix (music-only measured -40.6 dB, with narration -27.7 dB), while this one discriminates speech from silence on a CLEAN voice track, where speech sits near -37 dB and trailing silence far below. Reusing a single threshold for both makes the tail check misfire on exactly the case it exists to catch.
voiceover_tail_speech_threshold_db.title: Voiceover Tail Speech Threshold Db

voiceover_fit_tolerance_seconds.description: How much longer than the video a voice-over may run before it counts as overrunning. TTS commonly carries 200-400 ms of trailing silence that can be clipped harmlessly.
voiceover_fit_tolerance_seconds.title: Voiceover Fit Tolerance Seconds

input_schema.title: RunInput

output_schema.description: Structured verdict plus every measurement behind it.

warnings.description: Things worth a look that are not hard failures.
warnings.title: Warnings

integrated_lufs.description: EBU R128 integrated loudness of the final audio.
integrated_lufs.title: Integrated Lufs

speech_band_mean_db.description: Mean volume in the 1-3.4 kHz speech band.
speech_band_mean_db.title: Speech Band Mean Db

likely_has_voice.description: Whether the mix appears to contain speech, from the speech-band measurement. Heuristic, not ASR.
likely_has_voice.title: Likely Has Voice

voiceover_fits.description: Voice-over fits inside the video within tolerance.
voiceover_fits.title: Voiceover Fits

voiceover_overrun_seconds.description: How far the voice-over exceeds the video.
voiceover_overrun_seconds.title: Voiceover Overrun Seconds

voiceover_truncated_tail_is_speech.description: When it overruns: whether the segment that would be cut contains speech rather than trailing silence. True means a sentence gets clipped.
voiceover_truncated_tail_is_speech.title: Voiceover Truncated Tail Is Speech

output_schema.title: RunOutput
